general.name: Docker - Containers Differ From Expected [Lin]
general.description: Alerts when an expected Docker container is stopped or gone; reports unlisted ones. Read-only. Healthy when there is no Docker or no list yet. https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components

variables.name: usrMissingAction
variables.description: What an expected container that is stopped or gone does: Alert, or Warn (named in the status only).

variables.name: usrUnlistedAction
variables.description: What a running container not on the list does: Warn (named in the status only), Alert, or Ignore.

variables.name: usrUnlistedAfterHours
variables.description: 0-8760. An unlisted container only counts once it has run this long. Keeps upgrades and short tests quiet.
